learnings: One base exception per domain lets callers catch everything with a single `except`.
Categories (validation, availability, payment) let callers react differently.
Exceptions can carry data (`seats`, `requested`, `limit`) for precise messages.
pitfalls: Catch the most specific classes first – a base-class `except` placed earlier would swallow them.
